body.title: Show every document a chat turn presents for review, not only the last
body.reproduction: In the VS Code dev chat, have a turn call insrc_present with two pending documents in one call, for example a Story's BUILD record and its code review. Observed: the review pane shows only the last one (the code review); the first (the BUILD record) is never shown, though insrc_present answers that both are presented. Expected: the reviewer sees every document the turn presented, so none awaiting a decision is missed. Seen 2026-10-18 with BUILD-dced43851723554f-s1 and CR-dced43851723554f-s1: the user approved the code review and never saw the BUILD record that carried the completion decision.
body.rootCause: The chat's review presenter opens each declared document, in order, through the review pane host (vscode-plugin/src/chat/review-presenter.ts:108-117, wired at vscode-plugin/src/extension.ts:590). The review pane holds one opened document: each open increments a sequence number and an open whose response arrives after a newer open is dropped (vscode-plugin/src/chat/docs-review-panel.ts:1450-1456). Two opens in a row therefore leave only the second document showing, and nothing tells the reviewer another declared document is waiting. The daemon side of insrc_present (src/mcp/server.ts:967-969) promises the chat opens exactly the documents named, so the controller has no signal that one was hidden.
body.fixIntent: Every document a chat turn presents for review stays reachable until the reviewer has seen it: when a turn presents more than one, the reviewer can see that several were presented and move between them, and none is silently replaced by a later one. A single presented document behaves as today. The fix keeps the existing guard against a slow, stale open overwriting a newer one, and stays consistent with the open-supersede race already filed as ISSUE-605c70574633ed67 in the same open path.
